chunks: And from him, from a number of our companions, from Sahl, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abu Hamzah, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), that he was asked:
Are the rituals performed without ablution? He said, 'Yes, except for the Tawaf around the House, for indeed it is a prayer.'
ai.seo_question: Do I need to perform ablution (wudu) for all Hajj rituals or just Tawaf?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that while most Hajj rituals do not require ritual purity, Tawaf al-Ka'bah is an exception because it is intrinsically linked to prayer (Salah), thereby necessitating Wudu. This ruling highlights the unique status of the Ka'bah as a sacred space where physical purity facilitates spiritual communion, a principle deeply rooted in Shia jurisprudence. The distinction underscores the theological view that Tawaf is not merely circumambulation but a devotional act akin to Salah, demanding the same preparatory state of purity.
